bio: Postdoctoral Research Fellow Health Policy and Management, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Health Policy and Management I am an applied microeconomist with a special focus on health and labour economics. I obtained my PhD from the Norwegian School of Economics. Currently, I am working on projects concerning the specialization of physicians in the US health care workforce and the implications of physician specialization on patients. BSc, Economics and Social Sciences Vienna University of Economics and Business
